'''2007 Kashyyyk Regionals Casey Anis DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2007 Kashyyyk Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' BHBM
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
